## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

X358 is the eight-fascicle *huìběn* 會本 ("combined edition") of *[Wénjù 文句](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0306)* (T1785) and its *[Wénjù jì 文句記](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0307)* (T1786), the *wénjù* counterpart to [KR6i0311](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0311) (X356). Like its companion, the work interleaves the parent commentary by [智顗](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E9%A1%97) / [灌頂](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%81%8C%E9%A0%82) with the subcommentary by [知禮](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%9F%A5%E7%A6%AE) at the corresponding lemmata. The longer extent (eight fascicles vs two for X356) reflects the greater length of the parent *wénjù* commentary and the *jì* subcommentary as compared with the *xuányì* / *shíyíjì* pair.

**Abstract**

Compiled by [明得](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%98%8E%E5%BE%97) in the late Ming, c. 1560–1588 (his mature productive period; cf. DILA A008323). The four-author attribution in the colophon — 隋天台智者大師說 / 唐章安灌頂大師錄 / 宋四明法智大師述 / 明月亭明得大師會 — is unusual and reflects the *huìběn*'s status as a single unified working text drawing the entire commentarial layering of the *wénjù* line into one book. As with X356, of pedagogical rather than original-doctrinal value, but the standard form in which Late-Míng and Qīng-dynasty Tiāntái students engaged the parent commentaries.

Related canonical texts: [KR6i0306](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0306) (金光明經文句 / T1785), [KR6i0307](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0307) (金光明經文句記 / T1786).
